register.title: Evan Daniel's n271 certificate at 757b40b, issue664
register.headline: A smaller packing of 271 squares from Evan Daniel's basin explorer, refining Couzo's packing, certified exactly
register.source_checks: The author reports that his two exact rational checkers, verify_cert.py (separating axes) and verify_cert2.py (polygon intersection), accept the certificate and its 21-group regularized view at the same side. The source calls it a refinement of #561's packing and a different local minimum: its load-bearing tilt angles match #561's group for group within 0.12 degrees except that four squares near 31.7 to 32.0 degrees are three here; it reports a KKT local minimum strict modulo 54 exact flat motions, 259 corner-corner contacts with no corner-corner MILP descent and 4 rattlers. Those are numerical evidence at 80 digits, as the source says, not proofs. No source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Evan Daniel (https://github.com/evand/square-packing), whose basin explorer started from the register's witness for 271 and found this packing with one tilt-swap move and a re-polish, and credit Francisco Couzo's #561 packing and Nate Chaoweeraprasit's SQUISH packing (#500) it refines, as the issue asks. The search, the checks and the request were done with Claude (Claude Code) under Evan Daniel's direction.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then adopt at 271.
